root_causes.description: Currency service experiencing extreme latency spike (p99_latency_ms z>1000 vs baseline 1.98±2.5e-16), propagating through checkout dependency to frontend. Despite extreme z-score, frontend shows no latency anomaly (z=-0.36), suggesting contained impact or graceful degradation.

evidence.observed_value: p99 latency z>1000 vs baseline z=1.98±2.5e-16

root_causes.description: Recommendation service experiencing extreme CPU utilization (z>1000 vs baseline 0.02978±0.0017) and severe memory pressure (z+122.56 vs baseline 9.912e+07±5.2e+04). Both anomalies exceed incident window duration of ~7 minutes, suggesting resource exhaustion or runaway process.

Payment service experiencing memory pressure (z+10.97 vs baseline 1.311e+08±1.7e+05) with secondary latency impact (p99_latency_ms z+7.88). Memory anomaly sustained over incident window, potentially causing OOM risk or garbage collection pauses affecting downstream checkout dependency.

remediation_steps: Investigate currency service dependency - check for downstream database latency or circuit breaker issues causing p99_latency_ms spike
Restart recommendation pods to relieve extreme CPU and memory pressure, investigate for memory leaks or runaway computation
Add memory monitoring and alerts for payment service to prevent OOM incidents, review recent deployment changes
